text: Private sharing is live. Now Devon has to get real people into the right seats so reps and managers can actually do their jobs.
Cascade Ridge already has a flat Service branch: Service Manager and Service Rep, both reporting straight to the VP of Customer Service.
Devon assigns Hannah Reyes and Tobias Lindgren into Service Manager, and every West and East rep into Service Rep -- reusing what's already there.
He builds two permission sets, Warranty_Claim_Service_Rep and Warranty_Claim_Service_Manager, so each group gets exactly the access their job needs.
Next: building the Flow that automatically routes every new claim to the right regional queue the instant it's created.
